flags.message: A general web search for Pickering/disruption/Thomas precedent unexpectedly surfaced a FedCourtsAI result at https://www.fedcourtsai.org/cases/scotus/9026000522/ whose headline advertised a 5% chance of certiorari for this target case. I did not open the result or inspect the underlying prediction, and excluded the forecast from the assessment, using the frozen 5.172958% reached-rate anchor and provisioned facts instead. Because the numerical headline was visible, inadvertent anchoring cannot be ruled out; independence should be discounted accordingly. No disposition was revealed or used.
